<!-- The recommended route (Theme n, then Iteration n), used on the Course Guide and on the
     Self-Study and DataLab overview pages. A wrapper class marks the start: .start-theme
     (Theme 1) or .start-iteration (Iteration 1, after Theme 1). Styles: styles.css, route figure block. -->

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 360 448" role="img" aria-labelledby="rf1-title">

  <text class="rf-col rf-col-dl" x="276" y="22">DataLab</text>
  <!-- theme n -> iteration n, iteration n -> theme n+1 -->
  <g class="rf-link">
    <path class="rf-first-link" d="M156 64 H222" marker-end="url(#rf1-arrow)"/>
    <path d="M156 132 H222" marker-end="url(#rf1-arrow)"/>

    <rect x="52" y="318" width="104" height="36" rx="18"/><text x="104" y="336">Theme 5</text>
```
